title: Gashlycrumb
mechanic: A lookup table read from a file

scenario.title: Lookup tables people edit by hand
scenario.body: The program reads any alphabet file, so it works for the NATO alphabet (Alfa, Bravo, Charlie) or any small config table. Files people edit by hand have '# comments', indented lines, blank lines, Windows line endings and, from Notepad, an invisible mark before the first letter. The book takes the first character of every line, whatever it is. Read real files without breaking any of the author's tests.

character.name: Lexi
character.role: a llama who keeps the alphabet scrapbook

tagline: Lexi the llama keeps a scrapbook with one page for every letter. Type a name and Lexi finds the page for each of its letters.

brain_blurbs.book: Files each line under its very first character, whatever it is.
brain_blurbs.real: Skips notes, blank lines and hidden marks before filing a line.

rules.test_usage: Explains itself when you ask for help
rules.test_bad_file: Says so when the scrapbook file doesn't exist
rules.test_b_c: Finds two pages, B and C, in order
rules.test_y: A capital Y works as well as a small one
rules.test_o_alternate: Can read a different scrapbook file
rules.test_bad_letter: Says "I do not know" for 5 and CH
rules.test_nato_alphabet: Works with any alphabet, like Alfa, Bravo, Charlie
rules.test_notepad_mark_is_ignored: Ignores the invisible mark Windows Notepad hides at the start of a file
rules.test_indented_lines: Spaces before a line don't hide it
rules.test_comments_are_not_entries: A line starting with # is a note, not a page
rules.test_blank_lines_are_ignored: Empty lines don't mess anything up
rules.test_windows_line_endings: Files made on Windows work too
rules.test_table_from_a_pipe: Can read the scrapbook from a pipe
